title: Post Grid Card
description: The post card the homepage "Tales from our trails" carousel renders, and the same card the LSX post-grid block uses wherever it appears. Landscape image above a tinted panel carrying a centred title, an italic byline in brand orange, and the excerpt. Measured from `.home #primary .home-post-carousel.lsx-block-post-carousel` on 2026-08-20: panel #F7F5F2 (neutral-200 exactly), title #60483B at 23px with sentence case, byline 13px italic #CC7F16, image 600x400 rendered at 204px tall. The byline is the only place on the site where brand orange carries running text; it is set on the tinted panel, where brand-500 measures 3.06:1 and cannot hold 13px copy, so it is carried at brand-600 here — the same AA correction style.md 12.5 applied to body copy and the pagination.
